How We Got
Here
We met at a wedding, which everyone finds funnier than we do. Eight years, two cities and one very patient dog later, here we are.

We are not doing speeches at dinner. We are doing them between courses, so nobody has to wait.

Come early, stay late, and please do not bring a gift that needs carrying home.
